cohort: Very low birth weight (VLBW) and extremely low birth weight (ELBW) infants born between 01/01/2009 to 01/31/2020
finding: Using delivery criteria to guide antibiotic initiation in preterm infants led to a decrease in antibiotic use without increasing the incidence of confirmed infection, death, or transfer within the first week of life.
mod_finding: Delivery criteria were associated with decreased antibiotic initiation among low-risk ELBW infants delivered by Cesarean section without labor or membrane rupture.
birth_weight: very low birth weight and extremely low birth weight
